steps.title: The Drawdown Protocol
steps.text: 2030. You lead a small coalition with one promise: a carbon-neutral world by 2100. Every year the world throws three crises at you; your policy cards are how you answer. Let's learn the table in one minute.

steps.title: The three pillars
steps.text: Money funds every card. The carbon ledger compares emissions E against absorption A - their balance drives everything. Happiness keeps society on board. Influence buys allies. Hover any number for details.

steps.title: The thermometer
steps.text: Net-positive carbon pushes warming up. Past +1.5 C the world enters Overshoot: harsher crises, straining sinks. At +2.0 C the run is lost - the one hard defeat.

steps.title: Three crises a year
steps.text: Each year three events land here: droughts, floods, unrest - and sometimes opportunities. Each shows what it will cost if ignored, and which card tags answer it. Answered crises do no damage and pay you back.

steps.title: Inspect a region
steps.text: Crises strike real places. Click any region now - its vulnerabilities, scars and alliance status appear in the inspector on the right.

steps.title: The Policy Board
steps.text: Your whole deck, always visible - dimmed cards state their reason. Each card shows its cost, its tags, and any returns it pays. Play as many as you can afford, up to five a year. Answering crises well unlocks new cards mid-run.

steps.title: Answer a crisis
steps.text: Play any card now. If one of its tags matches an open crisis, the crisis is answered on the spot - watch the crisis bar turn green and the reward land.

steps.title: Combos
steps.text: Cards played in the same year combine: bikes plus clean grids, forests plus water. When your tags complete a combo, it fires instantly with bonus returns - and every combo grows your chain, multiplying the next one. Chains are how late crises get beaten.

steps.title: Launch a project
steps.text: Projects are five-year commitments: they charge upkeep every year, and completing one grants a permanent power. Abandoning one costs trust. Launch one now from the Projects column.

steps.title: Resolve the year
steps.text: Press Space: ledger, warming, happiness - and every crisis you left open strikes. Passing entirely is legal too: Space twice banks the money.

steps.title: Read the year
steps.text: The log explains every number: answered crises, combo payouts, project upkeep, ignored crises hitting. Resilience (happiness + adaptation) softens what you cannot answer. Unanswered disasters still open doors - watch for the green beat.

steps.title: Knowledge persists
steps.text: Press H to open the Knowledge tree. Every run - won or lost - earns Knowledge Points, and combos and seized opportunities add more. Defeat is never a reset.

steps.title: How it ends
steps.text: Win: reach 2100 with emissions at or below absorption. Lose: touch +2.0 C, any year. Answer the crises, chain the combos, hold the long projects. Good luck, Signatory.
